title: Agent Certificate v0 Canonical Unsigned Manifest
description: SCHEMA-1 (2026-08-25) typed, transmitted canonical unsigned manifest. Its load-bearing digest is role-separated: `sha256:` plus lowercase SHA-256 over UTF8(`traigent.agent_certificate.unsigned_manifest.v1`) || 0x00 || jcs_v1(this document). `manifest_digest` is computed over those exact canonical bytes. This document is produced before any signature exists and crosses the wire in full, embedded verbatim as CertificateSignaturesV0.unsigned_manifest.document. Every one of the TWELVE coverage labels is a required property with concrete typed content, including the disclosure profile identifier that is printed on the envelope. Subject, seal, claims, non_claims, tiers, and evidence_digests are deterministic projections whose order and equality a verifier MUST check; evidence_digests begins with the audit_report_digest binding even when claims is empty, then follows first occurrence while scanning claims and each evidence_refs array. The remaining sections bind disclosure, privacy, SDK, compiler/register, key-ring, and freshness context. No private artifact content, counts, names, paths, or free text are representable.

TierProjectionEntryV0.description: One deterministic tier projection entry, mirroring one claim in the manifest's `claims` section: claim_id + its per-claim tier. A verifier MUST check this equals `(claim.claim_id, claim.tier)` for every claim in the `claims` section, with no entry left over and none missing.

TiersProjectionV0.description: The `tiers` coverage section: one TierProjectionEntryV0 per claim printed in `claims`, same cardinality bound as ClaimsArrayV0. A verifier MUST reject a manifest whose entry count differs from `claims`'s length, or whose (claim_id, tier) pairs disagree with the claims actually printed — this is what makes 'tiers' a binding rather than a duplicate label (gap C1).

EvidenceDigestsProjectionV0.description: The `evidence_digests` coverage section is a bounded unique tuple whose FIRST entry is always the `audit_report_digest` binding (including when `claims` is empty), followed by the first occurrence of every other evidence reference while scanning claims-array order and each claim's evidence_refs order. Duplicate references collapse. The first digest MUST equal `sha256:` plus lowercase SHA-256 over UTF8(`traigent.agent_certificate.audit_report.v1`) || 0x00 || jcs_v1(audit_report) under the audit-report role domain; a verifier MUST reject omission, reordering, or substitution. Bounded at 16 claims * 64 evidence_refs each.

PrivacyModeSectionV0.description: The `privacy_mode` coverage section (gap C1: previously unrepresented). The build session's declared data-flow mode, signed regardless of whether a D2 claim is printed. When a D2 claim IS printed, its params.declared_mode MUST equal this section's declared_mode (verifier equality obligation; the two live in different parts of the document and Draft-07 cannot cross-check them once only manifest_digest crosses).

DisclosureProfileSectionV0.description: The `disclosure_profile` coverage section pins the exact bounded disclosure profile identifier and its mandatory selective-disclosure non-claim. It is covered by the issuer signature so the plaintext envelope field cannot be changed after signing without invalidating the manifest digest.

selective_disclosure_line.const: Data omitted from this disclosure profile is simply absent; selective disclosure is not proven.

KeyRingIdentifiersV0.description: The `key_ring_identifiers` coverage section pins the exact issuer key, trust ring, and issuer signature algorithm before signing. When client co-attestation is expected it also pins the exact client key and client signature algorithm. A verifier MUST check issuer_key_ref/trust_ring_ref/issuer_signature_algorithm here equal the issuer signature block, and when co_attestation is present client_key_ref/client_signature_algorithm here equal that block; client key and algorithm are an iff pair. Signature bytes themselves are never fields of this section or the manifest, avoiding algorithm/signature self-reference.

client_key_ref.description: Present only when a client co-attestation is expected; its presence/absence is itself part of what the signature covers.

client_signature_algorithm.description: Present iff client_key_ref is present; it is fixed in the manifest before client signing and must equal co_attestation.algorithm.

FreshnessV0.description: The `freshness` coverage section (gap C1/C2: previously unrepresented, and the root cause of C2 — 'co-attestation does not bind its nonce'). Carries ONLY the already-public anti-replay nonce; per this packet's explicit boundary, freshness does NOT carry a precise public timestamp or any other policy-sensitive disclosure pending its own Disclosure Register ruling — see certification_common_v0_schema.json#/definitions/PublicNonce ('Register entry 8': a public nonce 'does not prevent dictionary guessing' on its own, but binding it into the signed digest is what stops the nonce from being swapped after co-signing). A verifier MUST check this section's nonce equals certificate.signatures.co_attestation.nonce when co_attestation is present — closing gap C2, since the nonce now crosses in two places (this signed section, and the plaintext co_attestation.nonce field a server can look up without decoding the manifest) and their equality is exactly what a replay/substitution check verifies.

UnsignedManifestV0.description: The complete canonical unsigned manifest: exactly the twelve sections UnsignedManifestCoverageV0 pins, each required, additionalProperties:false so no thirteenth section — signed or otherwise — can be smuggled in without changing the coverage label list to match.

subject.description: Deterministic projection: MUST equal certificate.subject verbatim.

seal.description: Deterministic projection: MUST equal certificate.ledger_seal_projection verbatim.

claims.description: Deterministic projection: MUST equal certificate.claims verbatim.

non_claims.description: Deterministic projection: MUST equal certificate.non_claims verbatim.

compiler_register_versions.description: Deterministic projection: this section's five register-digest fields MUST equal certificate.semantics's five fields exactly (agent_certificate_v0_schema.json#/definitions/SemanticsBindingV0).
